{{Quote|Master, I need your help, quickly. I am surrounded.''"<br />"''You have already lost the battle, child. I've ordered your reinforcements to return.''"<br />"''No! I will destroy the Jedi. I'll show you!''"<br />"''You have failed me for the last time. You are no longer my apprentice. And now, you shall die.|Asajj Ventress is betrayed by Count Dooku during the Battle of Sullust|<ref name="Nightsisters" />}}
The '''Battle of Sullust''' took place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] clashed over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. While a Confederate [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Space warfare/Legends|waged]] an intense [[Realspace/Legends|space]] battle against a Republic [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] personally led the Separatists' [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] against the Republic task force. Spearheading [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighter]] attacks, Ventress destroyed the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of Skywalker and Yularen, before moving in to challenge Skywalker and Kenobi in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]], dealing losses all the while. However, her push for success soon saw interference from her own Master, [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].

Charged by his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Ventress to prove his true allegiance to his Master, Dooku ordered an attempt on his apprentice's life. After recalling Ventress's reinforcements, Dooku had the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] [[TJ-912/Legends|TJ-912]] and her [[TJ-912's Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|Separatist destroyer]] directly assault and destroy the [[Unidentified Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Battle of Sullust)/Legends|Separatist command ship]], where Ventress had [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaged]] Skywalker and Kenobi in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. With the Confederate fleet sustaining heavy damage, Dooku ordered TJ-912 to recall their armada from the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]]. However, both Ventress and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escaped from the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] prior to its annihilation. Presumed to have died at Sullust, the betrayed Ventress turned to her people, the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], for aid in taking revenge on Dooku.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|There is a disturbance in the Force. Your assassin, she has become very powerful.''"<br />"''Yes, my Lord. She is quite important to me.''"<br />"Too ''important.|Darth Sidious and Count Dooku, on Asajj Ventress|<ref name="Nightsisters" />}}
[[File:AnakinVentressDuel-Kamino.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Ventress acquitted herself in battle against opponents like Anakin Skywalker.]]
By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Nightsisters Date" /> the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] had become the most trusted<ref name="Clone Card: Acolyte Ventress">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_asajj.jpg|text=Clone Card: Asajj Ventress (Dark Acolyte)|nobackup=1}}</ref> and cunning [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="Nightsisters" /> As a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], Dooku considered taking Ventress as his own [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] apprentice to overthrow his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]],<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> in accordance with the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith's]] [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]].<ref name="Nightsisters Dataclip">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250ab02ce65fa0012d61db441506fc|text=Dataclip: Nightsisters|na=video file}}</ref> To that extent, Dooku trained Ventress in the Sith arts,<ref name="The Sultry Sith">{{InsiderCite|122|The Sultry Sith}}</ref> though he abstained from officially taking her as his Sith apprentice,<ref name="Clone Card: Acolyte Ventress" /> a decision of his that Ventress resented.<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous" />

Growing strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]],<ref name="Nightsisters Dataclip" /> Ventress supported Dooku's breakaway [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in its struggle against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At [[Time/Legends|times]], she [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|acted]] as Dooku's personal emissary to potential Separatist member [[Planet/Legends|worlds]],<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref> and on [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|other]] [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|occasions]], she operated as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]]<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref> and special agent.<ref name="Cloak of Darkness">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}}</ref> However, she primarily served as a Separatist field [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in a number of [[Battle of Teth/Legends|wartime]] [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|campaigns]].<ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref><ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref> When battle groups from the Republic and the Confederacy met in the<ref name="Nightsisters" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]'<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]] to do battle, it was Ventress who led the Separatists' assault.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

==The battle==
===Separatist pushes===
{{Quote|Looks like I'm her favorite!''"<br />"''I'm kind of disappointed. Only the ''droids'' follow me.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker, after Asajj Ventress divides her forces and pursues the former|<ref name="Nightsisters" />}}
The Sullust [[Star system/Legends|system]] became a battlefield when a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] from the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]&mdash;led by a [[Unidentified Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Battle of Sullust)/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]], in turn being flanked by two [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]] and six [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]&mdash;launched numerous [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] to [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] a [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] from the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. Commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] from the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Nightsisters" /> [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']],<ref name="Nightsisters Ep Guide" /> an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] and five ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] openly challenged the Confederate armada<ref name="Nightsisters" /> over the planet [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]],<ref name="Explore: Nightsisters" /> deploying [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]], [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]], and [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] to [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] the Confederacy's [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] and [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]]. The Republic's escort [[Starship/Legends|ships]]&mdash;comprised of three [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruisers]], a [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]], and a trio of [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|''Arquitens''-class light cruisers]]&mdash;additionally provided supporting [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire to counter the Separatist fleet's attack.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

[[File:BattleOfSullust-VentressAttack.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ventress leads the Separatists' assault on the ''Resolute'' and the Republic armada.]]
As the Republic's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] moved in to harass the larger Separatist [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], the Confederacy responded with similar offensives.<ref name="Nightsisters" /> While the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TJ-912/Legends|TJ-912]]<ref name="Nightsisters Ep Guide" /> supervised the Separatist fleet from [[TJ-912's Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|one]] of the ''Recusant''-class [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyers]], Asajj Ventress led their [[Droid/Legends|droid]] starfighters in a vicious assault on the embattled Republic task force. Spearheading the charge from her [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|''Ginivex''-class starfighter]], Ventress took several squadrons<ref name="Nightsisters" /> of the Confederacy's new, formidable [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]]<ref name="Nightsisters Dataclip" /> to target the ''Resolute''<ref name="Nightsisters" />&mdash;the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of Yularen<ref name="Hasbro Yularen">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2009 Basic Figure|pack=#07: Admiral Yularen|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW07_Yularen.asp}}</ref> and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Defenders of the Republic">''[[The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Republic]]''</ref> While the Republic's ''Consular''-class [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] began to fall to Separatist fire, Ventress had the tri-fighters of [[Trident group one/Legends|Trident Group One]] attack the ''Resolute''{{'s}} starboard [[Engine/Legends|engines]], while she sent [[Trident group two/Legends|Trident group two]] to assault the cruiser's port-side [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]]. Once the tri-fighters had done their work, Ventress brazenly maneuvered through the ''Resolute''{{'s}} intense [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire and blasted away at the defenseless [[Battleship/Legends|battleship's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], where Yularen and several [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officers]] were overseeing the battle. Although the ''Resolute'' was subsequently destroyed,<ref name="Nightsisters" /> Yularen was able to escape before its destruction.<ref name="Nightsisters Ep Guide" />

[[General/Legends|Generals]] Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] soon joined the battle in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B interceptors]], though they too ran afoul of Ventress and her armada of droid starfighters. When Ventress chased after the two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and directed laser fire at Kenobi's [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|interceptor]], Skywalker and Kenobi split up to divide the Dark Acolyte's pursuant forces. Driving the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] toward the Separatist fleet, Ventress personally went after Kenobi, while her tri-fighters were sent to assail Skywalker and his [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]]. Two trios of tri-fighters split up to pursue Skywalker, but the famed Jedi [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was able to maneuver around one of the ''Recusant''-class destroyers, causing the two groups of droid starfighters to crash into each other. With the Republic's [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ships]] bearing down on the Separatist frigates, Ventress pursued Kenobi past one of the Republic Star Destroyers and finally landed a laser shot on his starfighter, sending him careening toward the Confederacy's [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class]] [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]]. As Ventress followed Kenobi to the Separatist flagship, Skywalker caught up with them and compromised the engines of the Dark Acolyte's starfighter. Both of their ships now critically damaged, Kenobi and Ventress crash-landed in the main [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of the Separatist flagship.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

===The betrayal of Asajj Ventress===
{{Quote|Yes, my Lord. Ventress is battling the Jedi on board the command ship.''"<br />"''Turn your guns on our command ship and open fire!''"<br />"''But, my Lord, I calculate that will destroy Ventress, the Jedi, and all our forces.''"<br />"''Precisely.|TJ-912 is ordered by Count Dooku to betray Asajj Ventress|<ref name="Nightsisters" />}}
[[File:SkywalkerVentressKenobi-Nightsisters.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Abandoned by Dooku, Ventress duels Skywalker and Kenobi alone aboard the Separatist command ship.]]
As Separatist reinforcements were dispatched to the Sullust system, Ventress's growing powers, as displayed in the ongoing battle, caused [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]]. Suspecting that Dooku was training her as his own Sith apprentice to overpower him, Sidious demanded that Dooku [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] Ventress as an admission of loyalty. Not wishing to lose his valuable assassin but unwilling to disobey his Sith Master, Dooku complied with Sidious's demands. He recalled Ventress's reinforcements, and Ventress discovered his abandonment of her when she contacted him for assistance. Left by Dooku to die, Ventress faced the Jedi alone aboard the command ship. Skywalker soon joined Kenobi in the destroyer's hangar, freeing him from his damaged interceptor with the help of his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. The two Jedi then confronted Ventress, who&mdash;despite being injured from the crash&mdash;refused to surrender and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaged]] the Jedi in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. Ventress managed to evade several of her adversaries' attacks until Skywalker and Kenobi [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-pushed]] against her starfighter, at which point she unleashed a wave of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energy, capturing both Skywalker and Kenobi in a Force choke.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

However, Dooku's campaign to kill Ventress was not over. He ordered TJ-912&mdash;who was overseeing her own ''Recusant''-class light destroyer with an OOM command battle droid&mdash;to open fire on the ''Providence''-class command ship, despite the fact that such a move would destroy all of the Separatists' forces in addition to killing Ventress and the Jedi. TJ-912 obeyed Dooku's orders, and with the Republic and Confederate fleets still facing off against one another over Sullust, the tactical droid had her ''Recusant''-class destroyer turn on their own ''Providence''-class flagship. Moving her destroyer into attack position, TJ-912 ordered her [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] to direct turbolaser fire at the command ship and its main docking bay. The damage wrought by TJ-912's friendly fire shook the flagship, and Ventress subsequently lost her Force hold on the Jedi. In spite of the fact that the ''Providence''-class destroyer was failing and dangerously close to obliteration, the Jedi continued their duel with Ventress, though all three opponents were forced to dodge around her damaged starfighter as the listing cruiser caused it to drift. Eventually, Skywalker and Kenobi disarmed Ventress of [[Interlocking hilt|both]] of her [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|lightsabers]], and the unarmed Ventress was left cornered against her starfighter at [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-point.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

At that moment, TJ-912 ordered a ''Hyena''-class [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] to terminate its flight path in the command ship's main hangar, right at the location of the duel. The bomber crashed into the hangar on a [[Ramming/Legends|suicide run]], forcing Skywalker, Kenobi, and Ventress to dive for cover. In addition, two ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers moved in from the Republic armada and began to fire upon the flagship, further compromising the vessel. With damage increasing, the destroyer's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] operators ordered all personnel to abandon ship. Skywalker and Kenobi broke off from their duel with Ventress and escaped from the ship in their starfighters. Once the Jedi had left, Ventress piloted the wreckage of her ''Ginivex''-class starfighter&mdash;with its [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems still intact&mdash;out of the hangar, crashing through several battle droids in the process. She escaped moments before the flagship was completely destroyed. Not finding any survivors of the command ship via scanning, TJ-912 reported Ventress's apparent death to Dooku, who then ordered the tactical droid to recall the depleted Confederate fleet from the system.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Dooku. He betrayed me.''"<br />"''I know. I had hoped you would find your way to us sooner.''"<br />"''I ''will'' have revenge.''"<br />"''Yes, you shall, Sister. We will see to it.|Asajj Ventress and Mother Talzin|<ref name="Nightsisters" />}}
[[File:DookuNightsisterClash2-Nightsisters.png|thumb|right|250px|Cloaked by a [[Water of Life/Legends|potion]], Ventress, Naa'leth, and Karis confront Dooku on Serenno.]]
Darth Sidious was pleased with Dooku's obedience in killing Ventress, though Dooku was now without his most trusted assassin.<ref name="Nightsisters" /> Both Dooku and the Republic presumed that Ventress had been killed during the Battle of Sullust, though this was not in fact the case.<ref name="Witches of the Mist" /> The battle left a large debris field over Sullust, in which Ventress continued to survive in the derelict [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of her starfighter. She was eventually found by the crew of the [[GS-100 salvage ship/Legends|GS-100 salvage ship]]<ref name="Nightsisters" /> [[Raider (salvage freighter)/Legends|''Raider'']], [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by the [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Ratch/Legends|Ratch]].<ref name="Nightsisters Ep Guide" /> After killing Ratch and his crew, Ventress commandeered the ''Raider'' and returned to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to seek aid from her people, the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], in exacting revenge on Dooku for his betrayal. Once she had been healed by the Nightsisters and their leader, Mother [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], the jilted Ventress [[Mission to Serenno (Nightsisters)/Legends|set out]] with fellow Nightsisters [[Naa'leth/Legends|Naa'leth]] and [[Karis/Legends|Karis]] for [[Dooku's palace/Legends|Dooku's palace]] on the planet [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], where she intended to assassinate him. Posing as Jedi, Ventress and her Nightsister accomplices took along stolen Jedi lightsabers to engage the [[Count/Legends|count]] in combat.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

Following the Republic assault, Sullust, which had been a member world of the Confederacy, made strides toward changing its [[Politics/Legends|political]] allegiances. [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] replaced [[Beolars Bribbs/Legends|Beolars Bribbs]],<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> who had served as Sullust's [[Senator/Legends|senator]]<ref name="Sullustans Elect President">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_1.html|Sullustans Elect President}}</ref> as well as SoroSuub's [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|Chief Executive Officer]], with [[Siin Suub]], a Republic supporter.<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In the past, only Dooku's assassin was capable of such an effort. But she was presumed dead at the Battle of Sullust.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] provides the official name for the battle in "Witches of the Mist"|<ref name="Witches of the Mist" />}}
[[File:VentressDooku-COD.png|thumb|left|250px|The Battle of Sullust featured Count Dooku's betrayal of his apprentice, Asajj Ventress.]]
Created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="Nightsisters Ep Guide" /> the Battle of Sullust<ref name="Witches of the Mist" /> was featured in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] episode "[[Nightsisters (episode)|Nightsisters]]," which aired in [[January]] [[2011]].<ref name="Nightsisters Ep Guide" /> Count Dooku's betrayal of Asajj Ventress, the central element to the battle, was first alluded to at the [[August]] [[2010]] [[Celebration V]] convention by Series Producer [[George Lucas]], though the manner in which Dooku betrayed his apprentice was not specified.<ref name="Celebration V Play by Play">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/jon_stewart_george_lucas_main_event/index.html|text=''Star Wars'' Celebration Main Event: Play by Play}}</ref> The battle received its official "Battle of Sullust" name in the episode "[[Witches of the Mist]]," which served as the conclusion to the "Nightsisters" story arc that began in the eponymous episode.<ref name="Witches of the Mist" /> In addition to showcasing a number of starship models that had been created for the television series,<ref name="Nightsisters" /> the battle featured the series' debut of the droid tri-fighter,<ref name="Nightsisters Dataclip" /> as well as the series' debut of Ventress's ''Ginivex''-class starfighter. It also depicted the destruction of the ''Resolute'',<ref name="Nightsisters Ep Guide" /> which had long served as the flagship of Anakin Skywalker and Wullf Yularen.<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>

===Alternate storyline===
{{Dialogue|Tano|Master, are you all right?|Skywalker|I am now. With your help and Master Ma'kis, we can blow that witch out of the stars!|Ma'kis|Copy that, General Skywalker.|attr=Ahsoka Tano and Ma'kis'shaalas arrive at Sullust with reinforcements|src=<ref name="Nightsisters" />}}
In an early script draft of "Nightsisters," the battle progressed differently than the final version in the episode. In that version, the fact that Ventress is grossly outnumbered is much more palpable. Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and Jedi Master [[Ma'kis'shaalas/Legends|Ma'kis'shaalas]] arrive at Sullust with reinforcements in the form of four ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers and their own Delta-7B starfighters. Tano and Ma'kis assist Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi in chasing down the severely outmatched Ventress, whose ''Ginivex''-class starfighter is shot down and forced to crash-land inside the hangar of the Separatist flagship. Just after the four Jedi land in the hangar, a Republic starfighter attack shakes the flagship, allowing Ventress to gain the upper hand over her first opponent, Ma'kis, whom she kills. Further starfighter assaults force Skywalker, Tano, and Kenobi to abandon the fight and evacuate from the flagship. Ventress, meanwhile, hails Dooku for reinforcements and learns that she will not be receiving any help, just as the flagship explodes.<ref name="Nightsisters Archives">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]], "Jedi Temple Archives" Blu-ray feature for "[[Nightsisters (episode)|Nightsisters]]"</ref> This version would have created further [[Canon|continuity]] problems, as Ma'kis originally perished in the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Purge (comic book)|''Star Wars: Purge'']], which takes place in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], chronologically later [[in-universe]].<ref name="Purge">[[Purge (comic book)|''Purge'']]</ref> Nevertheless, this version did not make it past the 3D story stage of production for the episode.<ref name="Nightsisters Archives" />
